tests.full_command: root and tools/wails-pilot: go test -mod=readonly -count=1 ./...; go vet -mod=readonly ./...
tests.note: Backend package times are not total suite durations. One complete final frozen-source regression/vet ran in this same witness before both package builds.

native_proofs: Real b377a28051cb9594ddeb2da1ffe4252d418f0a6f and current-source self-contained unsigned packages built; actual Windows PowerShell 5.1 used without Go/Node in runtime PATH.

Actual ShellExecute .lnk activation of previous, updated and rolled-back original Wails/WebView2 releases, native pointer Verify chart UI nonce, exact PID/executable/source and original engine custody, strict PAPER_STOPPED capabilities.
Active uninstall/update/rollback/shortcut refresh refuses; modified and foreign link ownership refuses without removing application code or changing those link bytes.
Retained old engine, inserted unknown old asset and altered old maintenance tool each refuse uninstall before started marker; exact altered bytes preserved until fixture restores them.
Original stopped update copies only original W28E supported Pine/strategy files; browser, financial-shaped and unknown state stays version-local; full old/new stopped data parity across rollback.
Both distributions deleted; installed newer maintenance remains usable after rollback to old selected source.
Retained-version uninstall deduplicates the old/new/old selector chain and removes exactly two verified application versions: shell, engine and checked static/templates/strategies assets.

Every old/new data/profile file retained by name/count/hash; all maintenance files, original root receipts, unknown stage DLLs, root sentinel, retired shortcut note, maintenance note and unselected unknown code bytes retained.
All history-owned links removed after native completion using original ownership/hash/target checks.
Completed original uninstall marker remains byte-identical on refused automatic retry; installed old and new launch both refuse and no process lease appears.
Original WM_CLOSE normal shutdown checks exact retained native process handle zero exit, engine shutdown and original lease release.
unit_safety_proofs: All retained data, maintenance, unknown and selected receipt bytes preserved.
Concurrent original lease acquisition and retained uninstall cannot both succeed.
Real Windows locked file causes partial removal failure with original durable root-wide quarantine; prepared retained launch and automatic retry remain refused after releasing the file.
limitations: Unsigned engineering candidate, draft/unmerged; no owner installation or data touched.
Maintenance tools and proof/selection/transition receipts deliberately remain for inspection, together with all version-local data and unknown files.
Native removal refuses altered retained code/maintenance or unknown asset insertions before removal; it does not adopt or delete those bytes.
Any partial native deletion retains original uninstall quarantine; there is no automatic repair, retry, source promotion or data migration.
No installer GUI or Apps & Features registration yet; no full product/chart-render/Pine-execution acceptance claim.
next_gate: Native setup interface over the qualified installer and maintenance operations.
